There are at least two factors here.

- There is no version of Thunderbird that runs on iOS, so you will need to find another email app that can do IMAP and SMTP mail, which are the standard Internet email protocols. I don't use Apple products, so I can't recommend one, but I know they're out there. When you find one, set it up to use IMAP, not' 'POP3.

- The email program on your PC (Thunderbird, I presume) should also be set up as an IMAP account, not POP3.

If all devices that talk to your email server are using IMAP, they will all synchronize with each other and all will show the same emails. If any one of them is using POP3, they will likely get out of sync and create confusion.


The article below discusses IMAP and how it is an advantage in a situation like yours:

https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/imap-synchronization

This isn't Google or ChatGPT. You don't get instant answers for anything within 4 minutes. This is real people with real lives volunteering their time to help when they are able. Besides, you haven't described what the problem is.

If you're asking how to install Thunderbird, go here and download the installer for your unnamed operating system:

https://www.thunderbird.net/en-US/thunderbird/all/

If you're having a problem, please describe it in as much detail as possible, including:

- What version of Thunderbird?

- What is your operating system?

- Who is your email provider?

- Is this an IMAP account or POP3?

- What error messages do you see? Please quote them precisely and in full. Screen shots would suffice.
